listing.name: RedNeckEngineering - ArcadeMode 0.1.0
listing.summary: Adds a hullmod that increases ship resource capacity and reduces consumption, with adjustable multipliers accessible in-game.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hullmod that increases ship resource capacity and reduces consumption, with adjustable multipliers accessible in-game.

description:
Simple mod that adds a hullmod with:

x extra seconds of PPT

x CR Degradation multiplier

Supplies maintenance per month multiplied by x

Fuel usage multiplied by x

Supply usage to deploy a ship into combat multiplied by x

Cargo storage increased by x

Fuel storage increased by x

Crew capacity increased by x

All of these values can be modified on the LunaLib settings in the main menu, without the need to reload the game.

Images:

I just wanted to take my time doing stuff in SS without worrying about the ships resources (maintenance and fuel), and here we are!

Credits on the modinfo.json

Requires:

-LunaLib:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25658

-LazyLib:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=5444.0

GitHub and download:

https://github.com/OfficialZygorg/RedNeckEngineering_ArcadeMode/releases/tag/beta

All values can be adjusted in the LunaLib settings menu without reloading the game. Designed to reduce resource management stress during gameplay.
